question: Which techniques in tactic TA0006 are mitigated by M1027?

answer.headline: Gathered 7 record(s) from 1 source(s).
answer.narrative: The mitigation M1027 mitigates seven techniques within the TA0006 tactic. These techniques are T1556, T1003, T1558, T1555, T1552, T1110, and T1187.

claims.text: Found 7 ATT&CK record(s) including T1556, T1003, T1558 and more.

task.text: Which techniques under tactic TA0006 are mitigated by mitigation M1027?

results.sub_question: Which techniques under tactic TA0006 are mitigated by mitigation M1027?
results.query: MATCH (ta:Tactic)-[:HAS_TECHNIQUE]->(t:Technique) WHERE ta.attack_id IN $tactic_ids MATCH (t)<-[:MITIGATES]-(m:Mitigation) WHERE m.attack_id IN $mitigation_ids RETURN ta.attack_id AS tactic_id, ta.name AS tactic_name, t.attack_id AS technique_id, t.name AS technique_name, m.attack_id AS mitigation_id, m.name AS mitigation_name LIMIT 300
results.summary: Found 7 ATT&CK record(s) including T1556, T1003, T1558 and more.
